entries.decision: Resolve registered dataset, universe, price view and policies; reject any unresolved or unauthorized input.
entries.rationale: A run must not consume unknown, unauthorized, unvalidated or physically inconsistent data.
entries.title: Fail closed before replay

entries.decision: Allow declared gaps under policy, emit gap evidence and never manufacture a bar.
entries.rationale: Invented bars would contaminate causality, availability and execution evidence.
entries.title: Preserve missing minutes without price imputation

entries.decision: Bind the bounded fixture to quote_guarded_1m and validate the binding before replay.
entries.rationale: Execution proxies must not use daily-adjusted or split-normalized prices as fills.
entries.title: Use quote-guarded raw 1-minute view

entries.decision: Order replay deterministically by available_at and ticker, with gaps preceding bars on ties.
entries.rationale: Event order must reflect when information became available and remain reproducible.
entries.title: Observable-at ordering

entries.decision: Source and preflight hashes are mandatory; mismatches fail closed.
entries.rationale: Replay must bind to the inspected bytes rather than a mutable path.
entries.title: Mandatory hash verification

entries.decision: Reject any decision not scheduled before its proxy execution timestamp.
entries.rationale: A fill cannot be backdated to information that was not yet observable.
entries.title: Mechanical decisions are scheduled before proxy execution

alternatives_considered: treat mechanical short fill as tradability proof
entries.decision: Permit short mechanics for engine validation while keeping tradability not evaluated.
entries.rationale: Correct short PnL arithmetic does not prove borrow availability or locate feasibility.
entries.title: Separate short mechanics from tradability

entries.decision: Maintain separate cost components, cash ledger, account state and gross-to-net reconciliation.
entries.rationale: Net results must reconcile from fill-level economic events rather than a manually asserted summary.
entries.title: Derive cash, costs and net PnL from fills

alternatives_considered: round rates to cents at serialization
entries.decision: Serialize and calculate rates at sub-cent precision; round monetary postings only at the declared boundary.
entries.rationale: Rounding a per-share rate before multiplication materially changes costs.
entries.title: Preserve sub-cent rates

entries.decision: Use bar_based_execution_profile_v0_1; reserve quote-aware execution.
entries.rationale: The bounded fixture guarantees bars, not quote-level execution semantics.
entries.title: Primary V0.1 execution profile is bar based

entries.decision: The first eligible fill opportunity must occur after decision and submission under the contract timeline.
entries.rationale: A bar used for a decision cannot also provide an earlier or simultaneous fill.
entries.title: No same-bar lookahead

alternatives_considered: apply generic adverse slippage to limits
entries.decision: Buy limits fill at or below the limit; sell limits fill at or above it; price improvement is disabled in V0.1.
entries.rationale: Adverse slippage beyond a limit changes the order's economic meaning.
entries.title: Limit protection cannot be violated

entries.decision: Buy-side stop base is max(stop, open); sell-side stop base is min(stop, open), followed by adverse slippage.
entries.rationale: Filling a crossed stop at the stop level is optimistic when the next bar opens through it.
entries.title: Stop gap-through uses adverse open

entries.decision: V0.1 subset is MARKET_PROXY, LIMIT, STOP_MARKET_PROXY, FULL_FILL_ONLY and DAY; partial fills are reserved.
entries.rationale: The first simulator must not imply unsupported partial-fill or liquidity realism.
entries.title: Bounded first fill simulator subset

entries.decision: Keep FUTURE_PROVIDER_REGISTRY_INTEGRATION, RunPreflight state consumption, StateReplayFeed, physical StateBundle reads and state-driven strategy execution unauthorized. Treat Applied Architecture root documents as context only.
entries.rationale: Provider–consumer compatibility was not opened after executable semantic gaps in the provider audit.
entries.title: Freeze consumer integration

alternatives_considered: continue with distributed living documents only
entries.decision: Maintain this CTO authority layer and trace every future gate to code, tests and runs.
entries.rationale: Implementation history alone cannot answer authority, rationale, supersession and allowed-claim questions.
entries.title: Separate authority from executable evidence

entries.decision: A source bar is evaluable only when order_submission_timestamp <= source_bar.ts_start; bars started before order submission are not evaluable.
entries.rationale: Deterministic fills require an exact rule for whether an order submitted at a bar start may use that bar.
entries.title: Exact source-bar eligibility

entries.decision: Use PASSTHROUGH_SOURCE_PRICE_WITH_DECLARED_DECIMAL_PRECISION; define fixed per-share price adjustment and BPS formulas; reject computed fill_price <= 0.
entries.rationale: Hash-stable fill simulation requires exact tick policy, slippage formulas and invalid-price handling.
entries.title: Deterministic tick and slippage semantics

entries.decision: Define V0.1 cost formulas, side applicability, zero/nonzero borrow constraints and canonical result precedence before implementation.
entries.rationale: A deterministic fill simulator must produce one canonical result and one reproducible cost sequence for each input.
entries.title: Deterministic costs and outcome precedence

alternatives_considered: single precedence list with EXPIRED_UNFILLED before gap/missing outcomes
entries.decision: Record one EVALUATION_OUTCOME per evaluated opportunity and one TERMINAL_ORDER_OUTCOME at order termination.
entries.rationale: A DAY order may see gaps or missing prices before final expiry; those evaluation results must not be swallowed by EXPIRED_UNFILLED.
entries.title: Separate evaluation and terminal order outcomes

alternatives_considered: allow PESSIMISTIC by name without defining event order
entries.decision: V0.1 uses FAIL_AMBIGUOUS_BAR_ONLY; PESSIMISTIC is reserved/not implemented.
entries.rationale: PESSIMISTIC without exact intrabar semantics is not deterministic across implementations.
entries.title: Ambiguous bar policy V0.1 fails closed

alternatives_considered: infer notional from side-specific cash movement
entries.decision: gross_notional = abs(fill_quantity) * fill_price.
entries.rationale: Cost and notional calculations need a single side-independent formula.
entries.title: Gross notional formula

alternatives_considered: REJECTED_BY_CONTRACT or FAIL_AMBIGUOUS_BAR according to implementation naming
apply declared PESSIMISTIC policy in V0.1
entries.decision: Ambiguous intrabar sequence under V0.1 produces EVALUATION_OUTCOME = FAIL_AMBIGUOUS_BAR and terminally maps to REJECTED_BY_CONTRACT; PESSIMISTIC remains reserved/not implemented.
entries.rationale: Final review found that ambiguous-bar handling still allowed implementation-specific naming and an operational PESSIMISTIC fallback.
entries.title: Canonical ambiguous-bar evaluation outcome

alternatives_considered: keep BT-GATE-006 open after accepted final review
entries.decision: Close BT-GATE-006 as CLOSED_PASS and open only the simulator authorization decision gate; implementation remains not authorized.
entries.rationale: Final external review accepted outcome enumeration, ambiguous-bar mapping and package integrity without findings.
entries.title: Execution semantics contract accepted for bounded implementation authorization decision

alternatives_considered: keep BT-GATE-009 open after final review pass
authorize implementation without preserving BT-GATE-010 acceptance gate
entries.decision: Authorize implementation of DETERMINISTIC_FILL_SIMULATOR_V0_1 only within the scope of document 08 and contract 07; all implementation acceptance remains assigned to BT-GATE-010.
entries.rationale: External final review of document 08 passed and confirmed scope, prohibitions, contract preservation, gate separation and UTF-8 readability.
entries.title: Authorize bounded deterministic fill simulator V0.1 implementation

alternatives_considered: implement broader quote-aware or partial-fill simulator
entries.decision: Record the bounded deterministic fill simulator as implemented and accepted by BT-GATE-010.
entries.rationale: BT-GATE-010 external acceptance review passed after reproducibility and outcome evidence corrections.
entries.title: Implement deterministic fill simulator V0.1 within authorized scope

alternatives_considered: split integration, manifest, strategy, ledger and metrics into microgates
entries.decision: Owner accepted BT-GATE-011 as the first single-strategy end-to-end historical engine-validation run with portable QG5 rerun evidence, pre-registered orders, current-event-only simulator invocation and online accounting inside the replay coordinator.
entries.rationale: The implementation proves the complete accepted path from data/replay through strategy, execution, accounting, ledger, metrics, manifest, deterministic rerun and package reproducibility without state consumption or edge claims.
entries.title: Implement single-strategy end-to-end backtest

alternatives_considered: start small-caps realism before portfolio mechanics
entries.decision: Authorize BT-GATE-012 for continuous implementation of the corrected multi-symbol, multi-session portfolio validation slice under the accepted contract; final implementation acceptance remains pending the final acceptance packet.
entries.rationale: Owner review accepted the corrected integral contract after the final evidence packet proved no active BT-GATE-012 implementation existed, with all five implementation trees inventoried and independently reproducible scan evidence passing.
entries.title: Authorize BT-GATE-012 multi-symbol multi-session portfolio slice implementation
Define BT-GATE-013 as physical historical replay slice
entries.decision: Define BT-GATE-013 as PHYSICAL_HISTORICAL_REPLAY_SLICE_V0_1, crossing only the boundary from accepted fixture replay to reproducible physical 013_ohlcv_1m_quote_guarded rows. Defer SMALL_CAPS_RIGOROUS_RESEARCH_RUNNER as a future gate family, not BT-GATE-013.
entries.rationale: A broad small-caps research runner would mix physical ingestion, PIT universe, short tradability, SSR, halts, liquidity/capacity, batch research and statistical validation. BT-GATE-013 must isolate physical row lineage, timestamp availability and deterministic replay first.
